The '''Taldot sector''' was the largest [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Planets in the sector included [[Balamak/Legends|Balamak]], [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]], [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]], [[Thanos]] and [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]].
